# Third-party files

The page makes no third-party requests; everything it needs is in this repository. Its own code uses no library.

## Fonts (`assets/fonts/`)

All files were downloaded unmodified from the npm registry through jsDelivr on 2026-09-27.

| File | Family | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inter-latin-opsz-normal.woff2` | Inter (variable, opsz + wght), Latin subset | @fontsource-variable/inter 5.3.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource-variable/inter@5.3.0/files/inter-latin-opsz-normal.woff2 | SIL Open Font License 1.1, `OFL-Inter.txt` |
| `inter-tight-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | Inter Tight (variable, wght), Latin subset | @fontsource-variable/inter-tight 5.3.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource-variable/inter-tight@5.3.0/files/inter-tight-latin-wght-normal.woff2 | SIL Open Font License 1.1, `OFL-InterTight.txt` |
| `jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | JetBrains Mono (variable, wght), Latin subset | @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono 5.3.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono@5.3.0/files/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2 | SIL Open Font License 1.1, `OFL-JetBrainsMono.txt` |

## Data

The videos are generated by WorldCast, except the reference recordings in the scene-state section
(`assets/media/scene-state/*/y_rec*`), which show frames of the OpenCS2 dataset (Blanchon, 2026,
https://huggingface.co/datasets/blanchon/opencs2_dataset), CC BY 4.0. The model was trained and evaluated on
recordings from that dataset.
